description: Lists every stage a UK bill has been through or has scheduled, in order, with the house and each sitting date: first and second reading, committee, report, third reading, Lords stages, consideration of amendments, Royal Assent. Saves researchers and public affairs teams from piecing together a bill's passage by hand. Source: UK Parliament Bills API. It gives dates, not debate content or votes; each stage_id can be passed to bill_amendments. (cost: 1 credit)

billId.description: integer, required, the Parliament bill ID (from bill_search), e.g. 4035

name: bill_stages_timeline
